name: meter
description: Context and cost of the main session: a line above the prompt, and a /meter pane with the window by category and what each turn added

band.title: Line above the prompt
band.description: Show context, the last turn's cost, the session's cost and the rate-limit windows in one line above the prompt. Off by default: the /meter pane and the context warning work either way.

limits.title: Rate-limit windows in the line
limits.description: Add the 5 hour and 7 day windows the last response reported, when the account has them.

warnAt.title: Warn at context %
warnAt.description: Raise a toast, once, when the context window passes this share, so a compact or a clear can come before autocompact starts to thrash. It arms again after the share falls 10 points below.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane when a session starts
autoOpen.description: Open the Context pane by itself at the start of every session, so the window and the cost are always beside the chat. Off: it opens only when you run /meter.
